mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.category_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (activity_no, title, cover_image, category_id, location, start_time, end_time, status, registration_method, max_participants, awards, rules, description, contact, fee_type, fee_amount) VALUES (#{activityNo}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, #{categoryId}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{registrationMethod}, #{maxParticipants}, #{awards}, #{rules}, #{description}, #{contact}, #{feeType}, #{feeAmount})
